rows.name: R1: unknown ASCII private keys are redacted at top level and nested
R1: credential-shaped unknown keys are redacted
R1: nested scan failures under unknown keys use redacted paths
R1: duplicate unknown keys are reported without their name
R1: duplicate contract-owned key reports only the fixed field name
R1: duplicate question IDs are identified by index and firstIndex only
R1: duplicate flashcard IDs are identified by index and firstIndex only
R1: duplicate choice IDs are identified by index and firstIndex only
R1: credential-shaped duplicate question IDs are not echoed beside the credential error
R1: answer keys and duplicate choice text never echo packet values
R1: directive and legacy-answer fields keep targeted errors from fixed allowlists
R1: benign contract-owned paths are kept exactly
R1: failure objects contain only allowlisted properties across stages
R1: unexpected internal errors return a fixed code without exception text
R2: preview retains normalized source claims
R2: generator-only source is flagged as an unverified claim
R2: createdAt-only source is flagged as an unverified claim
R2: note-only source is flagged as an unverified claim
R2: absent or empty source is not a claim
R2: references stay associated with their items and order
R2: preview keeps normalized item content and choice IDs for association
R2: preview-only information is absent from persistence output
R2: discardedOnSave discloses claims, references and export IDs
R2: guide-only, questions-only and cards-only preview data
R3: persistence material carries only the packet title
R3: canonical persistence JSON ignores key order and preview-only values
R3: text entry re-derives the byte limit and refuses an unstripped BOM
R5: questions with a sourceNotes-only guide are rejected, not silently dropped
R5: questions with empty summary and sections plus sourceNotes are rejected
R5: a summary that normalizes to empty does not make notes persistable
R5: omitted and empty flashcard and section arrays are treated alike
R5: credential-shaped or private notes are rejected without echo
R5: cards with guide sourceNotes preserve the notes
R5: a substantive guide with sourceNotes preserves them (summary or sections)
R5: combined guide, cards and questions preserve the notes
R5: questions with blank sourceNotes remain valid
R5: standalone sourceNotes remain an empty packet
R5: sourceNotes normalization is preserved into preview and payload
R5: canonical persistence content includes saved sourceNotes and changes with them
Control: trailing LF in a flashcard ID is rejected
Control: trailing LF in a choice ID and answer is rejected
